css: .kfs-print table td, .kfs-print table th { padding: 4px 6px; vertical-align: top; }
html:
Key Facts Statement (KFS)

As per RBI circular RBI/2024-25/18 dated April 15, 2024

{% if not doc.kfs_generated %}

The Key Facts Statement has not been generated yet. Please generate it on the Loan Application.

{% else %}

Part 1 - Interest Rate and Fees / Charges

1. Loan Proposal / Account No.{{ doc.unique_proposal_number or "" }}   Type of Loan: {{ doc.loan_type or "" }}
2. Sanctioned Loan Amount (in Rupees){{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.loan_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
3. Disbursal scheduleLump sum on sanction
4. Loan term{{ doc.repayment_periods }} months
5. Instalment details{{ doc.repayment_periods }} monthly instalments of {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.repayment_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
6. Interest rate (%) and type{{ doc.rate_of_interest }}% (Fixed)
7. Fee / Charges {% for c in doc.kfs_charges %} {% endfor %}
ChargePayable ToAmountIn APR
{{ c.charge_name }}{{ c.payable_to }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(c.amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}{{ "Yes" if c.included_in_apr else "No" }}
8. Annual Percentage Rate (APR) (%){{ doc.annual_percentage_rate }}%
9. Details of Contingent ChargesAs per loan product and sanction terms

Part 2 - Other Qualitative Information

Recovery agents clause{{ doc.recovery_agent_clause or "" }}
Grievance redressal mechanism{{ doc.grievance_redressal_clause or "" }}
Nodal grievance redressal officer{{ doc.nodal_officer_phone or "" }} {{ doc.nodal_officer_email or "" }}
KFS valid till{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.kfs_valid_till) if doc.kfs_valid_till else "" }}

Annex B - APR Computation Sheet

Sanctioned Loan amount{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.loan_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
Loan Term{{ doc.repayment_periods }} months
Rate of Interest{{ doc.rate_of_interest }}% (Fixed)
Total Interest Amount{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total_payable_interest, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
Fee / Charges payable{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.loan_amount - doc.net_disbursed_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
Net disbursed amount{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.net_disbursed_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
Total amount to be paid by the borrower{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.total_payable_amount, currency=frappe.db.get_value("Company", doc.company, "default_currency")) }}
Annual Percentage Rate{{ doc.annual_percentage_rate }}%

Annex C - Repayment Schedule

{% for s in doc.kfs_schedule %} {% endfor %}
Instalment No.Due DateOutstanding PrincipalPrincipalInterestInstalment
{{ s.instalment_no }} {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(s.payment_date) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(s.outstanding_principal) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(s.principal_amount) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(s.interest_amount) }} {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(s.instalment_amount) }}

{% if doc.borrower_acknowledged %}The borrower has been explained and has acknowledged understanding of this Key Facts Statement.{% endif %}

{% endif %}
name: Key Facts Statement
